description.p: A sport training application for Linux. Features a configurable round timer with pause periods and audio alerts, a training plan builder with multi-round circuit support, and an AI coach for generating personalized plans.

ul.li: Home page with quick access to recent and recommended workouts
Configurable round timer with adjustable rounds, duration, and pause
Training plan builder with timed and rep-based exercises
Multi-round circuits with configurable rest between rounds
AI coach for generating training plans with local or cloud LLMs
Built-in exercise database with 873 exercises
11 pre-built default training plans, including pop culture-inspired workouts
Training history with per-exercise logging and CSV export/import
Customizable sound effects for different events

description.p: Controller and preset polish for Steam Deck and desktop gamepads.

ul.li: Round timer: mark multiple favorite presets, delete custom presets, and save the current setup as a named custom preset with quick-start pills
Training plans: favorites are pinned to the top of the list, X toggles the favorite star, Y duplicates a plan, R2 creates a progression copy
Progression copies are percentage-based: +50% reps, +25% weight or +50% duration for everything completed last time
Gamepad: analog trigger support, L3 opens the Help window, R3 opens Preferences from any page, A toggles switches in the editor and activates Pause/+30s/Skip in the runner
Runner hints now show the B button "Stop Training" shortcut
The plans list refreshes whenever the page becomes visible again (edits, favorites and progressions show up immediately)
Gamepad focus works in the round timer setup, the presets dialog, the editor switches and the runner buttons
Favorite toggling no longer visually duplicates plans in the overview
Fixed crashes when leaving a running training and when opening exercise submenus with the controller
Progression tracking: personal records, estimated 1RM, volume load and adherence
New Progress page in the history with weekly volume and per-exercise records
“Progress this plan” creates a copy of a plan with more reps or weight
Round timer: prepare countdown, warm-up round, custom per-round intervals and a summary
History filters for plan and time period
First-run wizard that sets up starter plans
Undo for deleting plans, sessions and custom exercises
Help window with all keyboard and gamepad shortcuts
Gamepad buttons now work (the signal payload was read from the wrong argument)
AI Coach: streaming progress, reasoning display, cancel button and working error reporting
Scaled timer fonts are applied when a tab or the workout runner is opened
Plan list follows the visual order (plans between “New Plan” and Export/Import)

description.p: Complete rewrite in Rust with a redesigned workout experience.

ul.li: Rewritten in Rust (GTK 4 / libadwaita) with identical data formats — plans, history, settings and CSV files stay fully compatible
Runner redesign: circular progress ring with countdown, overall workout progress bar, color-coded phases (GO / REST / BREAK), next-exercise card
Round timer redesign: progress ring, phase colors, and one-tap presets (Boxing, Tabata, HIIT, Endurance)
Home dashboard with weekly sessions, total training time, and day streak
History: weekly/monthly training chart, totals, and month-grouped session list
Preferences rebuilt on Adw.PreferencesDialog with sound volume control and full backup/restore
Toast notifications for save/import/export actions
Keyboard shortcuts: Space = start/pause, S = skip, R = reset
Desktop notifications when a round timer or training completes
+30s button during timed exercises and rests; ring dims while paused
Duplicate plans with one click; per-plan statistics in the editor
Exercise picker: category filter alongside search
Atomic data file writes, drift-free wall-clock timers, detailed import feedback
Window size and last tab are remembered between sessions
Flatpak runtime bumped to GNOME 51

description.p: Favorite plans, improved editor UX, persistent preferences, better virtual keyboard, richer history logging, and a tristate color scheme.

ul.li: Mark training plans as favorites; favorited plans are pinned to the top of the list
Reorder editor actions so Start Training is the primary button
Add delete confirmation in the plan editor
Add Save button to Preferences and persist changes on close
Fix Controller & Deck Mode markup warning
Rewrite virtual keyboard with focusable keys, Backspace, Enter, Close, and Shift
Improve controller navigation for Training Plans and AI Coach
Log exercise start and finish timestamps in training history and CSV export
Add per-exercise set numbers and repeat exercises according to their configured sets
Add Color Scheme preference (Follow System / Light / Dark) applied immediately
Remove exercise image display from the UI; images are still preserved in exported data for compatibility

description.p: Exercise images are planned to be replaced with GIFs or short videos in a future release.
Steam Deck scaling fix: bottom controls and controller hints no longer cut off after switching tabs.

ul.li: Fixed font scaling to use content area dimensions instead of full window, preventing zoom-in on tab switch
Reserved bottom space for buttons and controller hints overlay in font calculations
Reduced timer font size ratio and cap for better fit on small screens
Scoped deck-mode button CSS to avoid inflating SpinRow controls
Added Fullscreen preference (Auto/On/Off) in Controller & Deck Mode settings
Replaced hardcoded 1280×800 baseline with dynamic allocation-based sizing
Debounced font updates on resize to avoid flicker during fullscreen transitions
Reduced controller hints overlay size for less screen obstruction

description.p: Image fix: reusable picture widget prevents workout resize. Plus editor layout, plan export/import.

ul.li: Fixed window resize when exercise images change during workout (single reusable Gtk.Picture)
Moved "Add Exercise" / "Browse Exercises" buttons above exercises list in editor
Export/Import training plans (JSON format)

description.p: Steam Deck: native resolution window, hints refresh on phase changes.

ul.li: Set window size to 1280x800 (Steam Deck native) when deck mode detected
Fixed Guide button idle_add callback (was returning tuple, not SOURCE_REMOVE)
Controller hints now update when workout phase changes (exercise/rest/round break/summary)

description.p: Steam Deck: auto-maximize, instant dark mode, skip exercise.

ul.li: Auto-maximize window on Steam Deck at startup
Guide button now uses deferred fullscreen toggle for Gamescope
Force Dark Mode now applies immediately (no restart needed)
Y button skips exercises during workout (not just rest)

description.p: Steam Deck bugfixes: fullscreen, dark mode, workout resize.

ul.li: Guide button now toggles true fullscreen (not maximize)
Added "Force Dark Mode" toggle in Preferences for Steam Deck
Fixed window resize when Done button appears/disappears during rep-based exercises
Updated README with correct controller controls

description.p: Full gamepad and controller support for Steam Deck and desktop.

ul.li: D-pad navigation with visible focus indicator across all pages
A: enter/activate, B: back/close, X: toggle/reset
Y: skip rest, Start: pause/resume/start workout
Select: preferences/keyboard, Guide: toggle fullscreen
L1/R1: switch tabs, L2/R2: scroll detail views
Exercise picker, settings dialog, and confirmation dialogs fully controller-navigable
Exercise editor: expand rows with A, adjust values with D-pad left/right
Fixed font scaling on fullscreen and maximize toggle

description.p: Initial release with round timer, training plans, AI coach, multi-round circuits, and history.
